chapter.title: Consoles and serial ports
chapter.para: The hypervisor writes its own messages to a serial port, which is its console, and connects the serial ports of the VMs to serial ports of the computer.

section.para: The hypervisor shall write its messages to the serial port of its console, if the configuration has one, at 38400 baud with 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit on a 16550 UART.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An operator needs to see what the hypervisor does.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: The hypervisor shall drop its messages if the configuration gives its console no serial port.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A hypervisor without a console must run as one with a console does.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_UART_HV_UART_WRITE_01 HLR_CONSOLE_HV_CONSOLE_INIT_01 HLR_CONSOLE_HV_CONSOLE_WRITE_01

section.para: The hypervisor shall write each of its messages as a whole, without it being mixed with the message of another CPU, with a carriage return before each line feed.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Several CPUs print at the same time.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: The hypervisor shall let a CPU that holds the console report a fatal error of its own.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A CPU that fails while it prints must still be able to say why.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_CONSOLE_HV_CONSOLE_LOCK_01

section.para: The hypervisor shall report on its console what happens to a VM: its start, the reason of its stop with the main registers of its vCPU, the parking of a vCPU, and the first access of its guest to a port or a register that it does not give.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An operator must know why a VM stopped.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability

section.para: The hypervisor shall connect the console of a VM (the guest port COM1 on x86_64, its first PL011 on arm64) to the serial port of the computer that the configuration gives it: directly if the guest can use that port itself (the host COM1 on x86_64; a PL011, COM1 or COM2, on arm64), otherwise by repeating each access of the guest on the port of the computer.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Each VM has a console of its own.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.para: The hypervisor shall connect the GDB port of a VM (the guest port COM2 on x86_64, its second PL011 on arm64) to the serial port of the computer that the configuration gives it, directly if the guest can use that port itself (the host COM2 on x86_64; a PL011 on arm64), otherwise by repeating each access, so that the GDB server of the JetOS in the VM can be used while the other VMs run.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: VMs are debugged one at a time, without stopping the others.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.para: The hypervisor shall keep the other VMs running while the debugger holds a VM stopped.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: VMs are debugged one at a time, without stopping the others.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_CPUS_HV_ASSIGN_CPUS_01

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall find the serial ports COM3 to COM16 as 16550 UARTs on PCI bus 0, in the slots that the script of its build gives them (slot 0x10 + n - 3 for COMn), and give each one I/O space.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The virt machine has only two PL011 ports; the others are PCI cards.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.
